role: SDK-callback event model (StrapEvent, StrapLinkLoss), the ordered event pump from the SDK queue to the main actor, and the per-link runtime state the link coordinator keeps between events.
types: StrapEvent: enum — reduced Polar SDK callbacks
StrapLinkRuntime: class (@MainActor) — per-link tasks, timestamps and reconnect flags owned by PolarManager.linkRuntime
toplevel: Stored-property initialisers: pump = StrapEventPump(), signal = StrapSignal(), flags false/nil.

units.does: Creates an unbounded AsyncStream<StrapEvent> and keeps its continuation.
units.entry: Built by StrapLinkRuntime's stored-property initialiser (PolarManager.init, PolarManager.swift:494).

units.does: Yields an event into the stream (callable from the SDK queue; yield order is delivery order).
units.entry: Called from PolarManager+Observers.swift:20,24,34,54,60,64,76,84,105,106 (Polar SDK observer callbacks on the SDK queue).

units.does: Finishes the event stream, ending the delivery loop.
On release cancels all six runtime tasks and finishes the event pump.
units.entry: Nonisolated deinit, on whatever thread releases the PolarManager (owner).

units.does: Cancels and nils the feed, health, settle and status-check tasks and clears linkedAt, settledAt, lastSampleAt and lastResubscribeAt (lastLinkResetAt, linkedPeripheralId and reconnect state are kept).
units.entry: Called from StrapLinkCoordinator.clearPreviousLink, linkDropped and noteUserDisconnect.
